Italy's Giorgia Meloni Marks Record Tenure; PM Modi Congratulates

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has become the longest-serving prime minister in Italy since the post-World War II era, completing 1,413 days in office. Her government has achieved a level of stability that has eluded previous administrations, which were often marked by crises and defections. Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India congratulated Meloni on this milestone, referring to her as a 'friend' and noting the achievement as a 'reflection of people's trust'. Meloni's tenure has been characterized by pragmatic policies and a stable coalition, defying critics.
